summary: Assign data-plane source paths to workstreams

delivery.outcome: Every tracked data-plane path is owned by exactly one workstream, so product tickets (canonical speed-up, live PostgreSQL test, engine benchmark) can be allocated.
nonGoals: Change data-plane code, contracts, tests, docs or CI behaviour
Change ownership already assigned by the managed base manifest

architecture.decision: Extend only the target-owned .governance/manifest.json: application owns conformance/**, benchmarks/** and reference/**; integration owns the standard text, contracts, schemas, profiles, examples, error catalog, locks, tools, QA evidence, Makefile and requirements; infrastructure owns .dockerignore and the conformance workflow. No responsibility moves between workstreams: every listed path was previously owned by none.
architecture.rollback: Close the PR; after publication revert through a new governance ticket.
